messages:
Maria (PM): Heads-up: Vertica pilot is asking for 99.99% SLA on Dedicated for GA. Need ops + commercial implications. Who can triage? @Ajay @Sam

Ajay (Eng): Important context: our current target is 99.9% windowed. Jumping to 99.99% -> ~10x lower error budget. Biggest risks: cold-starts, region failover, and preemption caps. Will put perf deltas in an RFC.

Sam (SRE): Operational asks: cross-region replication for control plane, pre-warmed hot pools, and faster failover automation. Also we should tighten alert thresholds to reduce noise. Proposal: `service_error_rate > 0.1% for 10m` -> page, else warn.

Ajay (Eng): Quick perf snapshot: p95=90ms, p99=320ms for seq=1024 on current Dedicated pools. Tail comes from KV-cache warmups and occasional host preemption. Remediations: 1) persistent hot allocs, 2) smarter KV priming, 3) lower eviction chattiness. Will sketch timelines.

Lina (Support): Docs/runbooks we need: customer-facing SLA doc, escalation ladder, KB: "What to expect during failover", and example SLA-credit calc. Can we get first drafts by Wed EOD?

Jordan (FinOps): Pricing note: premium SLA needs premium pricing and reservation. Recommend tiered product: Standard (99.9%) and Premium (99.99%) ~1.7-2x price multiplier + minimum commit. Also model storage costs for longer observability retention.

Maria (PM): Owners: Ajay = perf RFC + fallback policy, Sam = runbooks + alert matrix, Lina = docs & KB, Jordan = pricing model + contract clause. Internal sign-off next Tues, external reply Thu. Acks?

Ajay (Eng): Ack. Adding fallback plan: automatic model-variant fallback order: quantized-high-precision -> quantized-low-cost -> small-compact. Will include cost/latency deltas table.

Sam (SRE): Ack. Also callout: premium customers get 90d traces and 90d request logs vs 30d default. Storage uplift estimate needed. I'll draft SLO burn ceremony and oncall rotation impact.

Lina (Support): Ack. I'll start KB templates and canned responses for "SLA credit" flows. Need examples of incident-to-credit timelines.

Jordan (FinOps): Ack. I'll run unit-econ sims with uplift for reserved capacity, increased trace retention, and faster failover costs.

deploy-bot: staging smoke at 1769001450: `smoke: ok` :white_check_mark:

Maria (PM): One more: rollback and fallback comms. We should agree on an automatic customer notification policy if we trigger fallback (e.g., switch to quantized model). Lina can draft customer-facing language.

Lina (Support): Will do. Suggest a short template: "We experienced degraded performance and switched to our cost-tiered variant to preserve availability; we are restoring service and will follow up with details."

Ajay (Eng): I'll include a togglable routing policy: prefer latency-preserving variants for premium customers; default fallback for standard. Also include canary sequence for rollout of the pre-warm feature.

Sam (SRE): I'll map required infra changes and estimate ops effort (2-3 sres x 3 weeks) and add to RFC. Also propose a staging burn-in for 48h under GA-like load.

Maria (PM): Great. Meeting Mon 10am PT for pre-signoff. If you can't make it, drop notes here. Thanks. :thumbsup:
